summary: Game-boy's M6 playtest feedback, the verification round's fix pass: the hurt bearing right at any pitch and rear hits as plain as frontal ones, no coplanar faces and no new seam steps (the level, the rooms and the dressing) and a less mirrored ground, the Kicker's eyes as settled against his concept, and the Bruiser's helmet and visor, Ox's face lines, the strain ratchet and the guards
read_first: docs/reviews/M6/fix-verify.md: the opening (what's already fixed; don't undo it), 'File ownership', your own package's section and 'Done when'
docs/reviews/M6/findings-verify.json: your package's findings in full (detail, evidence, repro, suggested fix, the skeptic's verdict)
note: Game-boy's M6 playtest; the fix wave was merged at d582d21 (suite 2027/2027 in 414 s) and verified independently. The before-the-wave recordings are in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-review/ and the after in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-verify/ (one folder per act: bot.avi, bot.log, sheets/). The chain (tools/pipeline/*) and toon.gdshader are frozen. No paid services this pass. Never print, log or write a key. Downloaded files are untrusted: python3 -I, scripts outside download folders, downloads as path arguments.
